data.rationale: The proposal follows the same Booking → Xe → Mail draft → Discard sequence with nearly the right parameters, but it leaves out the "first hotel with review score ≥ 8" rule (it says only "open a hotel result"), the do-not-Reserve and do-not-Send constraints, and the From=EUR and Convert click. It also lists hotel name, EUR price and recipient email as parameters although they are derived values, and the recipient is {traveler}@example.com, so a builder would have to guess the hotel selection rule and the address format.
